title: Food building, truck and diner

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Link food to the places and people that provide it so the illustration communicates a living culture.
strategic_value: A food-related building, mobile vendor and diner can connect Helsinki food imagery across different settings.
demonstration: A pink brick facade occupies upper left, an orange food truck sits below, and a seated diner, pan and food fill the right on pale blue.
practical_value: Choose a venue, vendor or dining motif according to the food story being told.
